commitMessage: Add PATCH /projects/<id> to rename a project
title: Rename a project
requirement: Let a signed-in user rename one of their own projects through PATCH /projects/<id>. The route must require login, the new name must be validated, and the service function must be covered by a test.

title: Export projects
requirement: Add GET /projects/export, which returns the signed-in user's projects as JSON. Only authenticated users may export their projects.

commitMessage: Add archive_project() to the projects service
title: Archive a project
requirement: Add a service function that archives one of the user's projects. The new function must be covered by a unit test.

commitMessage: Add project search and the reporting API key
title: Search projects
requirement: Add a service function that searches the signed-in user's projects by name, with a test. Queries must be parameterised and credentials must come from configuration.
